2609.35065.title: TempoKV: Timely Staging of LLM KV Caches for Memory-Semantic Flash
2609.35065.paper_summary: Reusable prefix key-value (KV) caches can outgrow GPU memory in large language model (LLM) serving. A memory-semantic flash hierarchy offers SSD-backed capacity with a limited fast tier, but a logical KV hit is not necessarily ready for GPU retrieval. Demand staging exposes SSD latency, whereas immediate staging can reserve fast-tier capacity long before retrieval begins. We present TempoKV, a timing-aware resource-commitment layer that separates early knowledge of reuse from the acquisition of staging resources. It records reusable-KV hits as metadata-only claims and requests commitment when the runtime-estimated time until retrieval falls to the storage-estimated time needed to make KV resident and protected against eviction. These estimates adapt to runtime progress and staging state, while commitment remains subject to available protected capacity. We implement TempoKV in vLLM and LMCache on an SSD-backed CXL memory device without changing request scheduling. Across two models and three prefix cache ratios, TempoKV reduces protected fast-tier byte-time per request by 63-91% versus immediate staging while retaining much of the serving benefit of advance staging. In a fast-tier capacity sweep, output throughput and p95 time to first token (TTFT) remain nearly unchanged as capacity decreases from 100 to 25 GiB. Compared with unmodified LMCache's Device-DAX L1 configuration, TempoKV reduces p95 TTFT by up to 48.0% and increases output throughput by up to 27.8%.
2609.35065.paper_summary_zh: 可重用的前綴鍵值（KV）快取在大型語言模型（LLM）服務中可能會超出GPU記憶體的容量。記憶語義的快閃層級提供了以SSD為支撐的容量，並有一個有限的快速層，但邏輯KV命中不一定準備好供GPU檢索。需求階段暴露了SSD的延遲，而即時階段則可以在檢索開始之前很久就保留快速層的容量。我們提出了TempoKV，一個時間感知的資源承諾層，將重用的早期知識與獲取階段資源分開。它將可重用的KV命中記錄為僅元數據的聲明，並在運行時估計的檢索時間降至存儲估算的使KV常駐並防止驅逐所需的時間時請求承諾。這些估算會根據運行時的進展和階段狀態進行調整，而承諾仍然受限於可用的保護容量。我們在vLLM和LMCache中實現了TempoKV，並在不改變請求調度的情況下使用SSD支持的CXL記憶體設備。在兩個模型和三個前綴快取比率中，TempoKV將每個請求的受保護快速層字節時間減少了63-91%，同時保留了提前階段的許多服務好處。在快速層容量掃描中，隨著容量從100 GiB減少到25 GiB，輸出吞吐量和p95首次令牌時間（TTFT）幾乎保持不變。與未修改的LMCache的Device-DAX L1配置相比，TempoKV將p95 TTFT降低了最多48.0%，並將輸出吞吐量提高了最多27.8%。
